# wayfinder — Map of a large body of work

## 1. Name and localization

- **English name:** `wayfinder`
- **Translation:** Map of a large body of work.
- **Source skill:** [`SKILL.md`](https://github.com/PVMalove/agent-harness-next/blob/master/skills/vendor/mattpocock/engineering/wayfinder/SKILL.md)

## 2. Russian description

Presents work that is larger than one agent session as a map of decision tickets in the tracker and clarifies the path step by step.

## 3. Application

The source `SKILL.md` defines the exact order of steps, the entry conditions, and the limits. This page is a Russian pointer to the pinned upstream version.
